## Fix arc

- Initial emit found three authored-selector bugs (acronym token not in
  expansion map; `pick` indexes off by tokens; `City of X <dept>` city
  extraction returning the dept name) — fixed in the slot table +
  `_CITY_STOP` heuristic, re-emitted, re-verified.
- `sha256sum` absent on macOS → portable `_sha256` fallback in the script.
- Leak-test tightened from "any query word" to "serialized query↔id
  binding" (generic vocabulary like a state name is not the set).
